origin_statement: NEW PSI 안전 프로그램 개발 경험에서 출발해 게임·현장도감·훈련 콘텐츠로 확장된 하나의 브랜드 세계관

replacement_policy.real_or_unlicensed_company: Use NEW PSI CONSTRUCTION / NEW PSI 건설 when an in-world construction-company identity is needed.
replacement_policy.real_or_unlicensed_project: Use NEW PSI ZERO SITE 01 / NEW PSI 현장 01 when a project or site name is needed.
replacement_policy.manufacturer_or_product_brand: Use NEW PSI only when a readable mark is narratively useful; otherwise keep the object unbranded.
replacement_policy.anonymous_placeholder: Do not ship OO건설, ○○건설, A사, B사, 익명회사 or random pseudo-company names. Replace with the appropriate NEW PSI fictional entity or a role-only neutral label.
replacement_policy.real_apartment_or_site_brand: Do not reproduce it in shipped game art or text unless separately cleared. Use NEW PSI site identity.
replacement_policy.character_names: Named characters remain fictional human names and are not renamed to NEW PSI.

visual_marking_policy.isolated_equipment_rule: Field-guide equipment may remain text-free for thumbnail readability. If a company/manufacturer mark is visible, it must be NEW PSI; universal safety marks such as AED may remain.
